headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). No 'Inter' for headings. Never default to standard Bold, use Light or Black for extreme contrast.

body.rules: Clean, geometric legibility. Use text-gray-300 or text-gray-400 for secondary text to ensure high contrast against the dark background.

colors.rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Deep obsidian/navy anchors with high-saturation accent blocks. Tints of blue in grays. Avoid fully transparent overlays; use glassmorphism with 1px border-white/10.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant): bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10. Use for Sticky Headers and Brand Cards.
Grid Borders: border-collapse, subtle borders on right and bottom of items for data-heavy sections.
Noise Texture: Subtle SVG noise overlay to break the digital flatness.
shadows: No soft diffuse shadows. Use sharp 1px inner highlights and deep ambient glows (0 0 40px rgba(0,102,255,0.15))
motion: Masked line-by-line text reveal on hero load.
Hover/expand cards: Use layoutId or width expansions for interactive brand cards.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-32 for sections. Never cramp content.
layouts.grid: Bento Protocol Mode A. Asymmetrical grids, grid-cols-12 for complex layouts. Use col-span-full for impact.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm). Background electric_blue, hover state must lighten slightly with a glow effect.
components.cards: Cardless or Glass cards. No default Shadcn white cards.
components.badges: Overlines must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] font-medium.

media.image_rules: Max height 80vh on mobile. Wrap hero images in bg-black/40 to ensure contrast. Use grayscale + hover color for team members to maintain enterprise vibe.

hero_parallax.description: Sunset road with vehicles - kinetic hero parallax background.

timeline_logistics.description: Truck driving down highway - 'Shaping Transportation' storytelling timeline.

infrastructure_bridge.description: Concrete bridge infrastructure - 'Easy Brick' section or Mission.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion heavily. No complex 3D needed, rely on high-fidelity CSS and parallax.
3d_libraries.parallax: Use framer-motion (useScroll and useTransform) for scroll-based parallax on the hero image.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a single-page app with smooth scroll anchors. Setup @studio-freight/react-lenis at the root layout.

(1) Hero Section: Implement a masked line-by-line reveal for 'Building the Future of...' using Framer Motion (overflow-hidden wrapper with y: '100%' to '0%'). Add animated statistics counters using react-countup. Use hero_parallax image.
(2) Brands Section: Create premium animated glass cards. On hover, the cards should slightly expand and reveal a 'Discover more' arrow.
(3) Storytelling: Implement a sticky left column containing the timeline/map, while the right column scrolls through features. Ensure seamless Framer Motion transitions.
(4) Mission & Vision: Split screen with animated slow-moving gradient mesh background on one side.
(5) Leadership: Use CSS grid. Apply a grayscale filter on images by default, transitioning to full color on hover. Include LinkedIn icons.
(6) Office & Culture: Create an asymmetrical masonry/bento grid gallery. Implement hover zoom (scale-105) on images.

(7 & 8) Dashboards (Easy Truck / Easy Brick): Build realistic-looking CSS mockups (not just images) of dashboards within glass-morphic containers to represent the technology. Overlay glowing tech metrics.
(9) Why Choose Us: 4 feature cards with animated lucide-react icons and react-countup counters.
(10) Testimonials: Use react-fast-marquee for a premium auto-sliding review section with glass cards.
(11 & 12) Contact & Footer: Massive padding (py-32). Two column contact form. Premium dark footer.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays; use bg-black/40 to bg-black/60 to guarantee text readability.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
